items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: That was Bart Varsalona, Milt Bernhart, Harry Betts, Harry Forbes and me. Five bones.

ctx.x: And Shelly Manne was on the group. Who were your section mates at the time, do you remember?
That was Bart Varsalona, Milt Bernhart, Harry Betts, Harry Forbes and me. Five bones.
Wow. That’s a lot of people.
